page.layout: One column of text in small type, with mixed Latin, Hebrew and Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries. No marginal notes. Hebrew catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Panis jugis coctura non pellebat sabbathum, sed vesperà sab-bathi coquebant eum, Kimchi 1.Sam.21.6. Item זה מדחה קושיא של זה Hic repellit, refutat quæstionem sive objectio-nem alterius. דחיה Depulsio, Repulsio. -
דיה Idem quod של : unde לדידי Mihi, me, meum, &c.
דוכן דכן Suggestum, Suggestus templi vel scholæ, Gen. 49. v.6. in R.Salom.
דוכם, דוכוס, דוכס, Dux: Plural. תמנין דוכסין Octoginta duces, Cant.6.7. דוכסות Ducatus.
דלטור Delator, Detractor, Calumniator. Plural. דלטורין R.Sal. Exod.2.14.

דלל Attenuari. Hinc דלדל Attenuare, Infirmare, Debilitare. מדולדל Attenuatum, Infirmatum, Languidum. Hithpahel התדולדל vel נדלדל Attenuari, Languescere, Pendulum esse vel fieri, ut Languidum. דלות Tenuitas, Attenuatio Paupertas.
דלמא Ne forte, Ut non, Nequando.
דלם דלוקקמא Theca, Pera, Sacculus, R.Sal. Exod.16.14.
דמ דמין, דמיס, דמים Pecunia, Pretium pecuniæ. מוכרו בדמים יקרים Vendit illud pecuniis pretiosis, id est, pretio caro.

דמה Similem esse, Assimilari: נדמה Assimilatum, Pictura, similem alterius speciem referens. דמה Imaginari. כמדומה Sicuti videtur, ut apparet. דמיון Simile, Similitudo, Species, quæ sensui offertur, Phantasia: כוח דמיוני Facultas imaginatrix, Phantasia, R.Levi Prov.4.27. מה כוח המדמה Idem, R.Levi, Prov.2.6. Plural. צורות הדמיוניות Formæ imaginariæ, R.Levi, Prov.5.15.
דמם Silere, Hebr. דום Silens. Hinc, הנמצאות שלושה Entia triplicia sunt, Animatum, Vegetabile, (ut planta) & Silens (ut lapides & metalla) Kimchi Jer.10.8.

page.notes: Hebrew words in the entries are copied as far as legible; the Hebrew vowel points and some spellings in the first lines (זה מדחה, דמין/דמיס) are uncertain and not marked individually. The first Hebrew word on line 3 of the page, and the Latin/Hebrew mix of the "דלם" and "דמ" entries, are doubtful. The running head ד is a section letter printed at the top centre. Show-through and the digitiser watermark are excluded.
